SELECT FROM t_login_identifier WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND active_marker=1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_login_identifier SET status='RETIRED',active_marker=NULL,retired_at=#{retiredAt}, changed_by=#{changedBy},reason=#{reason},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status='ACTIVE' AND active_marker=1

UPDATE t_login_identifier SET status='ACTIVE',active_marker=1,retired_at=NULL, changed_by=#{changedBy},reason=#{reason},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status='RETIRED' AND active_marker IS NULL
